I have been farming this land in the North West for many years, and I know maize needs fertilizer to give a good harvest here, so I will buy two or three bags from the market. I will sow the local seed I saved from last season because it is what I know and trust, and my family will do most of the work ourselves, though I will pay some young men to help during the busy planting and harvesting weeks. We have no water for irrigation, and we will pull the weeds by hand as we have always done.
